license.value: Apache-2.0 (card metadata and HF license tag; no separate LICENSE file in the repo). No use restrictions beyond Apache-2.0 found. Training data, code and eval code stated as fully open.

params.value: Dense. 8,999,178,240 BF16 parameters (HF safetensors metadata); '7B-core' per card, i.e. about 6.95B body plus 2 x 1.03B untied embedding/lm_head (vocab 250,624 x 4096, tie_word_embeddings false). Active = total.

architecture.value: K2HorizonForCausalLM (model_type k2_horizon, custom_code). config.json: 36 layers, all full attention (sliding_window null, use_sliding_window false, no linear/Mamba layers, no MoE: num_experts 0, mlp_only_layers 0..35), hidden 4096, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads (GQA), head_dim 128, intermediate 12288 SiLU, RoPE theta 1e7 default type, max_position_embeddings 524288, vocab 250624, BF16.

context_length.value: 524,288 tokens native (max_position_embeddings; card: 'Native 524,288-token context from the midtraining stages onward'; midtraining stages 3-4 at 512K). vLLM recipe default variant uses a 131K baseline; vendor SWE-bench/TB2.1 runs used 256k.

modalities.value: Text in, text out only (card language en, pipeline text-generation; chat template raises on non-text content parts; Ollama tags list 'Text input'). No vision tower, so no --language-model-only needed.

thinking.how_to_toggle: Thinking cannot be switched off: the template has no enable_thinking and always opens the generation with <ifm|think> (high, default), <ifm|think_fast> (medium) or <ifm|think_faster> (low). Effort per request: vLLM extra_body chat_template_kwargs {"reasoning_effort":"high|medium|low"} or server-wide --default-chat-template-kwargs. llama.cpp b12407: per request chat_template_kwargs.reasoning_effort or the OpenAI reasoning_effort field (server-common.cpp ~L1566); reasoning_effort "none" or --reasoning off does NOT disable it because the parser only honours enable_thinking when the template mentions it (common/parsers/k2-horizon.cpp L28-29). Vendor: use high always, temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, >=32,768 output tokens. vLLM v0.33.0 parser only accepts the effort-specific end tag, and the model often closes medium/low with </ifm|think> (open issue vllm#62743), so use only high on vLLM. llama.cpp b12407 accepts both end tags (fix for llama.cpp#30246, closed 2026-11-12). Ollama: ifm/k2-horizon is tagged 'thinking'; effort control via Ollama not verified.

tool_calling.format: Template renders tools in a system '# Tools' block (presentation markdown default, or json/xml) and instructs calls as <ifm|tool_calls><ifm|tool_call>NAME\n<ifm|arg_key>k</ifm|arg_key>\n<ifm|arg_value>v</ifm|arg_value>...</ifm|tool_call></ifm|tool_calls> (tool_call_format xml default; json and xml_typed selectable via chat_template_kwargs). Tool results go in <|ifm|im_start|>tool turns.
tool_calling.evidence: chat_template.jinja render_call_instructions and render_tool_calls_block; vLLM v0.33.0 vllm/tool_parsers/k2_horizon_tool_parser.py (json/xml/xml_typed, streaming) registered as 'k2_horizon'; llama.cpp b12407 common/parsers/k2-horizon.cpp PEG parser for xml and json. Template is strict: it raises if an assistant history message has no thinking field (think/reasoning/reasoning_content/...), if tool parameters are not a dict, or if a schema lists 'required' names missing from 'properties'. vLLM v0.33.0 passes only the 'reasoning' key (renderers/chat_utils/chat_message.py L619-659), so a client that omits it gets an error; OpenCode v2.3.0 sends reasoning "" on every assistant message when compatibility.reasoningField is set (packages/ai/src/protocols/openai-chat.ts L568-604, L659-665). llama.cpp injects reasoning_content "" itself (k2-horizon.cpp L12-18). Vendor BFCL v4 67.0, AA tau3-Banking 27.6.

vllm.arch_supported: Yes, native: registry.py L147 'K2HorizonForCausalLM': ('k2_horizon', ...) at tag v0.33.0, model file vllm/model_executor/models/k2_horizon.py, recipe recipes/models/IFM/K2-Horizon-7B.yaml. No vLLM config class, so --trust-remote-code is required (loads configuration_k2_horizon.py).
vllm.min_version: Present in v0.31.0 per vllm#62743 environment; exact first version not checked. v0.33.0 confirmed.
vllm.best_checkpoint: cyankiwi/K2-Horizon-7B-AWQ-INT4 (compressed-tensors W4A16 int4 group 32 asym, lm_head BF16, 7.56 GiB) is the only vLLM checkpoint that reaches 64k on 16 GB, and only with FP8 KV. IFM/K2-Horizon-7B-FP8 (10.29 GiB) is official but tops out near 46k (FP8 KV, util 0.92) or 53k (util 0.95). Both were uploaded before the 2026-10-01 anti-doom promotion (FP8 weights 2026-09-03, AWQ 2026-09-24), so they carry the pre-FTPO weights (inferred from commit dates; FP8 card shows the pre-FTPO-like numbers SWE-V 70.6 / TB2.1 39.1).
vllm.kv_math: Budget 16303 MiB x 0.92 = 14999 MiB = 14.647 GiB. KV/token = 2 x 36 full-attn layers x 8 KV heads x 128 x 2 B = 147,456 B (144 KiB) BF16; 73,728 B FP8. BF16 IFM/K2-Horizon-7B 17,998,399,920 B = 16.76 GiB: does not fit (pool -3.32 GiB). FP8 IFM 11,053,505,536 B = 10.29 GiB: pool 14.647-10.294-1.2 = 3.153 GiB -> 22,958 tokens BF16 KV, 45,916 FP8 KV (util 0.95: 15.125-10.294-1.2 = 3.631 GiB -> 52,880 FP8 KV), below 64k. AWQ-INT4 8,122,473,440 B = 7.565 GiB: pool 5.883 GiB -> 42,835 BF16 KV, 85,671 FP8 KV. 64k needs 9.0 GiB BF16 KV or 4.5 GiB FP8 KV.
vllm.quant_on_sm120: FP8 block (128x128 weights, 1x128 dynamic activations): v0.33.0 ships csrc/quantization/w8a8/cutlass/c3x/scaled_mm_blockwise_sm120_fp8.cu, so a CUTLASS sm_120 blockwise path exists (kernel selection for this checkpoint inferred, not run). AWQ-INT4 compressed-tensors W4A16 group 32 asymmetric: Marlin path on sm_120 (inferred, not run). FP8 KV needs --attention-backend TRITON_ATTN on sm_120 per baseline (#61239).
vllm.serve_command: docker run --rm --device nvidia.com/gpu=all --ipc=host --memory 24g -p 127.0.0.1:8000:8000 -v $HOME/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface vllm/vllm-openai:v0.33.0 cyankiwi/K2-Horizon-7B-AWQ-INT4 --trust-remote-code --chat-template-content-format string --max-model-len 65536 --max-num-seqs 1 --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --attention-backend TRITON_ATTN --reasoning-parser k2_horizon --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser k2_horizon --default-chat-template-kwargs '{"reasoning_effort":"high","tool_call_format":"xml"}'
vllm.known_issues: vllm#62743 OPEN (2026-10-20): reasoning parser accepts only the requested effort's end tag; medium/low leak reasoning into content or the answer into reasoning, so stay on high. Template raises HTTP 400 on assistant messages without a 'reasoning' key (set OpenCode compatibility.reasoningField 'reasoning'). Template rejects tool schemas whose 'required' names a missing property. Untested: whether the parser sees reasoning_effort from --default-chat-template-kwargs (constructor reads kwargs['chat_template_kwargs']). BF16 needs about 22 GB per the vLLM recipe (vram_minimum_gb 22).

sampling: Vendor: temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, reasoning_effort high, max output at least 32,768 tokens (card Best Practices and recipe). generation_config.json sets no sampling, only eos [1, 250019]. No Unsloth repo or guide found in the HF search for K2-Horizon-7B.
speed_notes: Inferred decode bound, bytes read per token excluding the input-embedding table: llama.cpp Q8_0 about 8.5 GB -> 896/8.5 = about 105 tok/s ceiling, realistic 65-80 tok/s; Q4_K_M about 5.2 GB -> about 170 ceiling, realistic 100-120. vLLM FP8 about 9.0 GB (lm_head BF16 2.05 GB included) -> about 100 ceiling; AWQ-INT4 about 6.1 GB -> about 145 ceiling. KV reads add up to 4.8 GB per token at 64k q8_0/FP8 KV, so decode roughly halves near a full context. Always-on high-effort thinking (vendor IFEval mean 3.2k tokens, LiveCodeBench mean 15.6k) makes each agent turn long. Nothing measured on this machine.

opencode_fit.recommended_checkpoint: bartowski/K2-Horizon-7B-GGUF Q8_0 (8.92 GiB), all on GPU
opencode_fit.caveats: Independent AA TB2.1 44.2 and tau3 27.6 put this 7B dense level with Qwen3.6-35B-A3B while fitting fully in VRAM, so it is a strong small/fast candidate to measure, but: (1) thinking is always on and the vendor wants high effort and 32k output tokens, which with a 64k window leaves about 32k for input unless OpenCode limit.output is lowered to about 16k; (2) vLLM path is weak on 16 GB: BF16 does not fit, official FP8 maxes at about 46-53k, only the community AWQ-INT4 plus FP8 KV reaches 64k, and both quants hold pre-FTPO weights; vllm#62743 breaks medium/low effort; (3) OpenCode against vLLM must set compatibility.reasoningField 'reasoning' or the template raises on history messages; (4) strict template rejects malformed tool schemas (required name not in properties), check MCP tools; (5) the self-reported SWE-bench Verified 72.4 is unconfirmed independently; (6) org 'IFM' is not HF-verified though its history ties it to the LLM360 K2 line.
